message.content:
`docker start` is **not** the command to bring up the Docker daemon – it only starts *containers* that have already been created.  
To get the Docker service running on Windows you need to start the underlying Windows service (or launch Docker Desktop).

### 1. Using PowerShell (recommended)

```powershell
# Start the Docker Engine service
Start-Service -Name com.docker.service
```

If you want to stop it later:

```powershell
Stop-Service -Name com.docker.service
```

### 2. Using CMD

```cmd
net start com.docker.service
```

### 3. Launch Docker Desktop directly

If you installed Docker Desktop, you can start it from the Start menu, or run the executable directly:

```powershell
& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"
```

> **Tip:** After starting the service, you can verify it’s running with:
> ```powershell
> Get-Service -Name com.docker.service
> ```
> It should show `Status : Running`.

---

#### Quick recap

| What you want | Command |
|---------------|---------|
| Start Docker daemon/service | `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service` (PowerShell) or `net start com.docker.service` (CMD) |
| Stop Docker daemon/service | `Stop-Service -Name com.docker.service` (PowerShell) or `net stop com.docker.service` (CMD) |
| Start a specific container | `docker start <container_name_or_id>` |

So, to “start Docker on Windows” you’ll typically run the service‑starting command above, not `docker start`.
message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker daemon. To start Docker service, you need to start the Docker Desktop or the Docker Engine service. On Windows, you can use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can launch the application.

But the user might want to start Docker engine via command line. We can use `docker-machine start default` if using Docker Machine. But likely they want to start Docker Desktop. There's no direct `docker start` to start the Docker daemon. So we should explain that `docker start` starts containers, not the Docker service. To start Docker service, use `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service`.

We can also mention that if Docker Desktop is installed, you can start it from Start menu or run `& "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`.

Thus answer: cannot use docker start; use net start or Start-Service. Provide command.

Also note that if using Docker Desktop, you can start it manually. If using Docker Engine as a service, you can start it via PowerShell: `Start-Service -Name com.docker.service`.

Thus respond accordingly.
